about: The Rook attack's big Rook and the rooked halo (js/features/rook-attack-feature.js ROOK_SHEETS hover and halo), from Tiny Speck's CC0 vector SWFs. hover: glitch-overlays rook_fly_forward.swf DefineSprite_17 (rookFlyForward, 68 frames of 828x501, every frame but 18 and 52 doubled), its 36 distinct frames (frameList) drawn at 0.599 into the 496x300 cells (the 1x sheet's scale, so zoom 3 x 0.599); the Rook hangs at 0.82 of the 960 px view and swoops to 1.85, so its 3x is 1488x900 cells (193 MB decoded, 3 MB of lossless WebP) and ships as three 64 MB parts, loaded when the Rook first shows. The side-view silhouettes (rook-side.webp) are drawn at 0.11-0.2 and stay 1x. halo: glitch-items misc/emotional_bear/emotional_bear.swf scene rooked_halo, root frames 479-508 (sprite 0, frameRange), drawn at 0.87 over every rooked target. Run: node tools/vector-sprites/build.mjs --manifest tools/vector-sprites/rooks.json
